reviews.review_description:
Where do I start? How about the inclusion of Meta Quest Achievements that had me trying different shots and building up a streak right from the beginning! 

What started as a few quick throws, ended with me trying to sink a full court shot from across my living room.

It's addicting and FREE?! What a perfect way to start the summer.

MR is absolutely a great choice for this game. It’s really cool to see the game in the room and still have spatial awareness while you’re playing. The room scan and hand tracking features are nicely integrated and feel seamless. The pull-and-release mechanics work beautifully. Leaderboards and achievements are also chef’s kiss features!

reviews.review_title: Thanks For it Being Free and Simple!
reviews.review_description:
It’s free and not buggy.

Small suggestion. The ball to hoop ratio can be smaller. Increasing the size of the hoop is probably better than increasing the size of the ball if that makes sense. It is a bit difficult to make some shots
The magic is in the details. I'm really loving all the visual feedback in the game! Now I just need a bit more practice to climb that leaderboard. 😄
